title: settings.yaml exists but never sets networkExposure -> unknown, not pass
titleZh: settings.yaml 存在但从未设置 networkExposure -> unknown,不是 pass
why: The measured fact is that this key is usually absent. An absent override means the deployment relies on a built-in default the collector cannot read from this file, so 'no LAN exposure' is unproven and the verdict must be unknown.
